name: Cheese
summary: **Cheese** is a [[kind:cut|cut]], a single clone selected from a pack of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]] seeds by an anonymous grower in England in the late 1980s. The clone spread through the UK cannabis scene from the mid-1990s by way of the Exodus Collective, a community group near Luton. Big Buddha Seeds later released a stabilized feminized version.
